items.title: fix(build): ignore tool scratch churn in boundary topology walks (#13…
items.summary: fix(build): ignore tool scratch churn in boundary topology walks (#132719) The extension-boundary topology snapshot walked every entry under installed roots, so transient tool scratch (vite's node_modules/.vite-temp config bundles, jiti/vitest caches) minted mid-compile flipped the before/after namespace digest and killed pnpm check:changed extension-lint preparation with 'Boundary configuration or resolution topology changed during compilation', discarding a completed native emit. Skip dot-entries under installed roots except .pnpm: package names cannot start with '.', so bare-specifier resolution never enters them, while pnpm's virtual store stays in the walk. Install-driven metadata changes remain covered by lockfile and .modules.yaml content hashes. Accepted tradeoff: vite's EACCES/deno fallback writes .timestamp-*.mjs next to the config file outside installed roots and is not excluded; an unwritable node_modules breaks pnpm itself long before this scanner. Reproduced live: prepare-extension-package-boundary-artifacts racing a real vite loadConfigFromFile loop failed at the seal step pre-fix and completes post-fix with 429 transient temp files churning; warm rerun reports every unit fresh. Regression test fails pre-fix with the exact production error.
